# Upgrade Plan

## Overview

Upgrade **PhotoAlbum-Java** to the latest LTS versions: Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x (Spring Framework 7.x).

This upgrade includes:
- JDK upgrade to Java 25
- Spring Boot upgrade to 4.x
- Spring Framework upgrade to 7.x
- Jakarta EE migration (`javax.*` to `jakarta.*`)
- Dependency updates for Spring Boot 4.x / Java 25 compatibility

## Tasks

See `tasks.json` for the detailed task breakdown.
